name: Web Research Comparison to Ddoc
query: Compare React, Vue, and Svelte for building modern web applications and publish as a ddoc
expected_behavior: Searches the web for framework comparisons, benchmarks, and ecosystem analysis
Performs at least 3 web searches covering different comparison aspects
Gathers information on each framework from authoritative sources
Searches existing ddocs for 'React Vue Svelte' to avoid duplicates
Creates comparison matrix table with key criteria
Provides detailed pros/cons analysis for each framework
Includes a clear recommendation with rationale
Uses [Title](URL) markdown links for all citations
Includes a Sources section at the end
Uses descriptive title indicating comparison topic and date
Returns the blockchain-synced link to the user
success_criteria: Comparison format used with matrix table
All three frameworks analyzed (React, Vue, Svelte)
Comparison matrix includes at least 4 criteria
Each framework has pros and cons listed
At least 3 sources cited with [Title](URL) format
Ddoc created and blockchain link returned
